WARNING: This file is NOT where your settings are stored.
This file is only used to display the settings in the game.
The file you are looking for is 'settings.txt' in your saves folder.
If you want to change your settings, edit that file instead.

disasters: This may result in up to 1/3rd of your Clan dying in one moon.
modded_kits: Gives larger litters, and higher kit death chances
tnr_mode: Cats can be spayed/neutered by Twolegs
Kittypets, loners, and Clan cats caught by Twolegs now have a chance of ending up spayed or neutered.
sprite_scaling: Cat sprites on profile will scale based on size
On the profile screen, cat sprites will be scaled based on current size.
showheight: Show exact cat shoulder height on profile
Adds exact shoulder height in inches to cats.
metric_toggle: Converts heights from inches to centimetres.
adult_height_toggle: Young cats will always show their adult size and height
showxp: Show exact XP and nutrition status
Will turn 'experience: proficient' into 'experience: proficient (151)'; and 'nutrition: full' into 'nutrition: full (70)'.
fading: Allow dead cats to fade away
After 202 moons, dead cats will be unloaded, and saved separately. No family relations will be lost.
save_faded_copy: Save a complete copy of faded cats information
A complete copy of faded cat save info will be saved in plain-text.
backgrounds: Even with this off, the camp you choose will still affect the events you encounter.
new prefixes: New prefixes will be generated from a new pelt-based list
dynamic prefixes: Cats may change prefixes during ceremonies
new suffixes: Cats will gain suffixes based on skills, traits, and what they're honoured for.
ancient names: Suffix will be automatically capitalized and separated (eg. Black Claw)
no suffixes: New cats will never have suffixes
no special suffixes: New cats will have special suffix automatically hidden
outsider names: Prefixes will be picked from outsider name pool

deputy: Allow leaders to automatically choose a new deputy
The Warrior Code rules will be taken into account when choosing a deputy.
rel_deputy: Prioritise choosing a deputy that the leader gets along with.
12_moon_graduation: All apprentices will graduate at 12 moons.
retirement: Cats will never retire due to a permanent condition
When this setting is off, cats with permanent conditions will choose whether or not they want to retire.
healer_retirement: Allow healers to retire if there are enough healers
If remaining healers would be able to care for the Clan, elderly healers may choose to retire
mediator_retirement: Elderly mediators may choose to retire
become_mediator: Allow warriors and elders to choose to become mediators
Warriors and elders will have a chance to become mediators upon timeskip.
become_healer: Allow warriors and apprentices to choose to become healers
Warriors and apprentices will have a chance to become healers upon timeskip.
random med cat: Allow healers to be randomly selected on patrol
Healers can be selected with the patrol buttons +1, +3,+6.
patrol_lock_meds: Healers will always default to herb gathering patrols
Different types of patrols can still be selected manually
allow_mediator_patrols: Allows mediators to be selected for patrols as warriors

no_litters: While this setting is toggled on, no new litters or pregnancies should occur in the Clan.
affair: Allow cats to breed with cats that aren't their mates
This will allow mated and unmated cats to have kits with other cats they are not mated with. This includes, but is not limited to, affairs/cheating.
same sex birth: Allow all cats to get pregnant despite their gender and all couples to birth kittens despite same-sex status.
same sex adoption: If same-sex birth is disabled, this option greatly increases the chances of same-sex couples adopting.
single parentage: Allow cats to have kittens with an outside second parent
Allow cats to have kittens with a biological parent outside your Clan.
halfclan single: Litters with an outside second parent will always be half-clan.
outsiders single: Litters with an outside second parent will always be with an outsider cat.
surrogates: Allow cats to get surrogates for litters
Cats that cannot normally have biological litters can choose a surrogate if applicable.
only inclan surrogates: If surrogates are enabled, only Clanmates can be surrogates. Note: also selecting outsider surrogates will have no effect.
only clan surrogates: If surrogates are enabled, only cats from any clan can be surrogates. Note: also selecting Clanmate surrogates will override this. No effect in singleclan saves.
only outside surrogates: If surrogates are enabled, only cats outside the cat's clan can be surrogates. Note: also selecting Clanmate or Clancat surrogates will override this.
multisire: Allow cats to have litters with multiple sires
romantic with former mentor: Allow romantic interactions with former mentors
Allows mentors and the cats they trained to be romantic after they become warriors.
first cousin mates: Allow first cousins to be mates and have romantic interactions
Allows cats with the same grandparents but different parents to become mates.

low_rank: The Clan is fed from lowest rank to highest rank. Rank order can be found in the Help button on the top left corner of this window.
high_rank: The Clan is fed from highest rank to lowest rank. Rank order can be found in the Help button on the top left corner of this window.
youngest_first: The Clan is fed from youngest to oldest.
oldest_first: The Clan is fed from oldest to youngest.
hungriest_first: The Clan is fed from most to least hungry.
hunter_first: Proficient hunters are fed first, then the rest are fed according to chosen order.
sick_injured_first: Any injured or sick (this includes starving and malnourished) cats are fed first to help them regain their strength, then the rest are fed according to chosen order.
experience_first: The Clan is fed from most experienced to least experienced.
ration_prey: Healthy warriors will only eat half of the food they need, even if there is enough for the Clan.
auto_feed: Cats are automatically fed during timeskip in the order chosen via Tactics.

business as usual: The Clan has no specific focus and won't get any bonuses.
hunting: The Clan will focus on hunting, each working warrior (including deputy and leader) and each working apprentice will gather additional prey on each moonskip.
herb gathering: The Clan will focus on herb gathering, each healer and healer apprentice will gather additional herbs on each moonskip due to extra help from the warriors.
threaten outsiders: The relationship with cats outside of the Clan decreases due to intentionally threatening behavior from your warriors.
seek outsiders: The relationship with cats outside of the Clan increases as your warriors make efforts to sow seeds of friendship.
rest and recover: The Clan will take more care and time in their tasks and therefore the rate of injuries, illnesses and outbreaks will be reduced.
sabotage other clans: Your mediators and warriors work together to undermine the other Clans. Only available if you have a working mediator. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Clans you target.
aid other clans: Your mediator and warriors work together to help the other Clans with whatever they need. Only available if you have a working mediator. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Clans you target.
raid other clans: Your warriors begin crossing borders for resources. Prey and herbs will greatly increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will increase and the relationship with other Clans decrease. You will be able to choose which Clans you target.
hoarding: Your warriors begin stockpiling as many resources as they can get their paws on, regardless of their own safety. Prey and herbs will increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will also increase.
